en.summary: The wife of aircraft mechanic and influencer Lito Sousa discussed her experience caring for her husband, who was recently diagnosed with Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease and is undergoing experimental treatment.

stories.title: Copom mantém projeção para o IPCA no horizonte relevante em 3,2%

en.title: Central Bank maintains IPCA projection at 3.2% for relevant horizon
en.summary: Brazil's central bank kept its inflation forecast at 3.2% for the first quarter of 2028. Free prices inflation rose to 3.2% while administered prices inflation fell to 3.2%.

stories.title: Entenda o que está acontecendo no STF — e os próximos passos a partir de agora

en.title: Understand what is happening at the Supreme Court — and the next steps from now on
en.summary: Brazil's Supreme Court began deliberations on a possible investigation of ministers Alexandre de Moraes and André Mendonça by federal police. A procedural question raised by minister Gilmar Mendes prevented the topic from being discussed.

stories.title: Copom corta a Selic para 13,75% ao ano, em última reunião pré-eleições

en.title: Central Bank cuts Selic to 13.75% per year in final pre-election meeting
en.summary: Brazil's central bank reduced the Selic rate to 13.75% per year in its final meeting before elections. The decision came as the U.S. Federal Reserve raised rates.

stories.title: HUAWEI WATCH GT 7 chega ao Brasil com 56% de desconto

en.title: HUAWEI WATCH GT 7 arrives in Brazil with 56% discount
en.summary: Huawei launched the HUAWEI WATCH GT 7 in the Brazilian market with over 56% off the suggested price on launch day. The smartwatch is available in 41 mm and 46 mm versions focused on sports, health and wellness.

stories.title: Organizações lançam plataforma que conecta eleitores a candidatos do Legislativo

en.title: Organizations launch platform connecting voters to legislative candidates
en.summary: Civil society organizations launched a new version of TemMeuVoto, a free and non-partisan platform that enables voters to identify legislative candidates whose positions best align with their own views.
